caseNameFull: Cohnstaedt v. Immigration and Naturalization Service
attorneys: Osmond K. Fraenkel argued the cause and filed a brief for petitioner., L. Paul Winings argued the cause for respondent., With him on the brief were Solicitor General Perlman, Joseph W. Bishop, Jr. and Charles Gordon.

opinions.text:
Certiorari, 338 U. S. 890, to the Supreme Court of Kansas.

Per Curiam:

The judgment is reversed. Girouard v. United States, 328 U. S. 61.

The Chief Justice, Mr. Justice Reed, and Mr. Justice Clark dissent.
